scope: Independent narrow verification of 1998 hospital-district claims in build_root.py against OIC 1429/1998, 1430/1998 and 1601/1998; no broad discovery and no source-file changes.
method: Read operative clauses and relevant schedule sections in local text extractions; visually inspected OIC 1429 cover/witness and schedule pages 4,11,14,23,24,25, OIC 1430 cover/incorporation/witness pages 1,3,5, and OIC 1601 cover/Appendix/property schedules pages 1–3. Read remaining transfer recipient clauses and Schedule D in the local original-derived text.
result: No discrepancy in requested dates, counts, rename identities, dissolution identities, transfer-deadline distinction, or four Greater Vancouver recipient groups. One non-blocking omission in the abbreviated VGH relationship condition should be made explicit.

discrepancies.target: build_root.py: Greater Vancouver → Vancouver General Hospital assets_transferred_to relationship conditions
discrepancies.current_text: Parkade; operating-funding restrictions and specified debt obligations
discrepancies.source_locator: PDF page 2, Appendix section 5(3), read with sections 4 and 5(1)–(2)
discrepancies.finding: The abbreviated condition identifies the funding and debt duties but omits the express consequence: if VGH fails to comply with either duty, the Schedule C item transfers to and vests in the government. The corresponding South Fraser relationship already names possible reversion.
discrepancies.suggested_text: Parkade; no health-program funds may cover its operating expenses or debt; Schedule D interest/principal payments required; noncompliance with either duty transfers and vests the parkade in the government.
discrepancies.effect_on_claims: No change to the 1 January 1999 initial transfer date or VGH recipient identity. Do not assert that the contingent later vesting actually occurred without further evidence.

verified_scope_summary.asset_deadline_handling: Correct: 31 December 1998 is a completion deadline; the schedule makes vesting depend on the effective date of each actual transfer. Null actual_transfer_date is appropriate.
verified_scope_summary.renames: Correct: Cariboo-Coast to Cariboo-Chilcotin and Coast Garibaldi to Sea to Sky effective immediately under the 19 November 1998 supplementary letters.
verified_scope_summary.stuart_nechako: Correct: incorporation and witness dated 19 November 1998; the 1999 provisional budget clause is not a delayed commencement.
verified_scope_summary.greater_vancouver: Correct: OIC approved 17 December 1998 expressly dissolves and transfers effective 1 January 1999; South Fraser Health Region, Vancouver/Richmond Health Board, Vancouver General Hospital and provincial government are the four recipient groups. Surrey review/reversion, VGH funding/debt conditions, and residual assets/liabilities are source-backed, subject to the omission noted above.
